entrance: Through the central courtyard of Dire Maul in the middle of Feralas: a door on the east wall, a door from Eldreth Row, or the back door at the Lariss Pavilion with the Crescent Key.

7488.objective: Bring back Lethtendris's Web. Lethtendris drops it.
7488.note: Courier Hammerfall in Ironforge gives the breadcrumb Feathermoon Stronghold. The boat to Feathermoon leaves from the Forgotten Coast on the west shore of Feralas.

7489.objective: Bring back Lethtendris's Web. Lethtendris drops it.
7489.note: Warcaller Gorlach in Orgrimmar gives the breadcrumb Camp Mojache.

7441.objective: Get the Book of Incantations from Pusillin. Talk to him each time he stops, and fight him on the platform at the end of the chase.
7441.note: He also drops the Crescent Key. The exit at the back of his room leads straight to Azj'Tordin.

5526.objective: Kill Alzzin the Wildshaper, loot a Felvine Shard from the Felvine behind him and seal it in the Reliquary of Purity.
5526.note: First do A Reliquary of Purity for Rabine Saturna: the reliquary lies in a building of Southwind Village in Silithus. The quest cannot be shared.

7463.objective: Kill Hydrospawn and bring his Hydrospawn Essence to Lorekeeper Lydros.
7463.note: Mages only. Lydros stands in the Athenaeum of Dire Maul West. The reward is the highest rank of Conjure Water.
